_about: Public-domain William Taylor (1821-1902), Methodist street preacher in San Francisco and missionary bishop for Africa, for the Word Hoard: Seven Years' Street Preaching in San Francisco (1857), California Life Illustrated (1858), The Model Preacher (1860), How to be Saved and How to Save the World (1866), Christian Adventures in South Africa (1867), The Election of Grace (1868), Reconciliation, or How to be Saved (1874), Infancy and Manhood of Christian Life (1875), Four Years' Campaign in India (1875) and Our South American Cousins (1878). William M. Taylor of the Broadway Tabernacle is another man. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 67 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
